jobs.title: Sales Director
jobs.description_text:
p(X) provides aggregated, institutional-grade digital asset liquidity through a curated network of global trading venues. In today's highly fragmented market, counterparties that trade directly with p(X) gain access to deep, diversified liquidity while simplifying execution and settlement. This eliminates the operational burden of establishing and maintaining separate relationships with multiple liquidity providers while at the same time allowing for superior execution quality.
p(X) operates as an independent business unit, separate from the Talos Platform business, governed by its own AML, compliance, risk management, and operational frameworks designed to meet the requirements of a regulated trading and liquidity provisioning business.
As a distinct legal entity, p(X) maintains its own balance sheet, counterparty onboarding processes, governance structure, and Board of Directors. While p(X) leverages certain shared corporate services — including Legal, Compliance, Finance, and Information Security — it operates independently from Talos, with its own management and staff, in all core commercial and operational activities.
We are hiring a Sales Lead/Director to drive counterparty acquisition, onboarding, and revenue growth for our p(X) liquidity provision business. This is a high-ownership, early-employee role responsible for generating leads, building strong counterparty relationships, and closing deals to support a fast-scaling pipeline.
The ideal candidate has exceptional communication skills, a proactive, problem-solving mindset, and a deep understanding of crypto institutional sales & trading workflows.
Responsibilities
Source, pitch, and close new counterparties (retail brokers, fintechs, funds, neobanks)
Own the full sales lifecycle: prospecting → negotiation → onboarding → activation
Expand our network of trading counterparties and products throughout 2027
Build and maintain long-term strategic counterparty relationships
Meet and exceed agreed-upon sales and activation targets.
Partner closely with Trading on onboarding, pricing, connectivity, and workflow improvements
Analyze market opportunities, track pipeline status, and produce clear sales reporting
Qualifications
7-10+ years in institutional trading sales (some overlap with crypto will be a bonus), with proven revenue-carrying responsibility
Strong background in institutional capital markets with demonstrable sales achievements
Existing crypto network or prior experience successfully growing a book of business in the ecosystem
Highly motivated and target-driven, with a track record of hitting or exceeding goals
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills
Data-driven approach to prioritization and decision-making
High sense of urgency, entrepreneurial mindset, and ability to operate autonomously

We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.
Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.
6 month FTC 
Multiverse is at an exciting juncture, one that requires transformation of both scale (10,000 to 100,000 apprentice learners) and technology (recognising potential of our expanded product, platform and AI offerings). Success in the short to mid-term will be defined by how well we execute against our strategy, how capable we are to continuously improve core operating metrics and process and how supported our 300+ coaches are to have a daily, positive impact to our apprentices and learners.
As a 
Post-Gateway Success Coach
, your primary focus will be on providing essential support and guidance to our apprentices as they prepare for their End Point Assessment (EPA) and resits. You will play a pivotal role in supporting our learners as they transition from on-programme learning to the successful completion of their EPA. You will be responsible for ensuring that learners are well-prepared, motivated, and engaged throughout this critical phase of their apprenticeship. Your role involves tracking engagement, facilitating EPA preparation, providing 1:1 support to Apprentices and, when needed, facilitating resubmissions. Additionally, you manage learner escalations and escalate when necessary. Your work contributes to learners succeeding in their EPA and continue their journey toward professional growth.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and oversee all post-gateway communications, experiences and escalations for learners focusing on an ultimate success metric of timely End Point Assessment pass.
Monitor the engagement of all apprentices in your assigned caseload and develop scalable intervention strategies to ensure apprentices stand the best chance of succeeding
Simplify administrative processes to maximise your time spent with apprentices to drive customer value

Demonstrated mastery of coaching best practices and/or openness to develop in this area
Passion for delivering the best learning opportunities and supporting others on their development journey, passionate about social mobility and equity with continual curiosity in AI and proactively engaging in upskilling.

jobs.title: Global Payroll Specialist
jobs.description_text:
About Us
Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
 $200M+ in ARR
, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.
We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
Joining Legora means three things.
We 
lean in: 
ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
We 
fight for excellence:
 high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
We
 grow together:
 as a team and with our customers.
Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
The role
We’re hiring a Global Payroll Specialist to help build and scale payroll as Legora continues to grow internationally. Working closely with our Global Payroll Manager, you’ll help ensure payroll runs smoothly across multiple countries while also shaping the processes, controls, and ways of working that will support our continued expansion.
This is not a role where you’ll spend most of your time processing payroll yourself. Instead, you’ll coordinate with external payroll providers, review and quality-check their work, and help improve how we work as we enter new markets. As the function develops, there will also be room to shape parts of the role based on your strengths and interests.
 
What You Will Be Doing
Coordinate monthly payroll cycles across multiple countries
Act as a key contact for external payroll providers
Make sure payroll is delivered accurately and on time
Carry out validations, reconciliations, and checks before payroll is finalized
Help ensure payroll follows local regulations and internal processes
Support audits by keeping documentation clear and up to date
Help build and improve payroll processes as we grow into new countries
Create clear workflows and documentation so our ways of working can scale
Work with payroll data from HiBob and ensure inputs are accurate and complete
Partner closely with HR, Finance, and external vendors
Step in as backup to the Global Payroll Manager when needed
Who You Are
What matters most is your mindset: you are curious, eager to keep learning, and excited by the opportunity to grow in a global payroll role. We are looking for someone who brings structure, ownership, and a willingness to figure things out in a fast-moving environment.
You also bring:
5+ years of payroll experience
Strong understanding of payroll controls and processes
Detail-oriented with strong analytical skills
Comfortable working with HRIS and payroll systems
Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer
At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Head of Tokenization
jobs.description_text:
Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.
At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth.
We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. You’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.
 
Head of Tokenization
 
We are seeking a senior Product leader to drive our strategic expansion from crypto-assets into all tokenized assets so the Talos platform has front-to-back support for tokenized equities, bonds and other emerging asset classes on-chain. You will own this strategic initiative, working closely with the Head of Product Strategy and other product managers to drive go-to-market strategy; client and partner engagement; and setting overall project delivery direction. This position is ultimately accountable for P&L in a new product line.
Responsibilities
 
Lead specification, high-level design and delivery of a full tokenized securities venue platform and its integration into Talos, inclusive of all key elements
Market structure
Liquidity provision, clearing & settlement
On-chain vs. off-chain integrations
Identity and KYC/AML
Regulatory reporting
Direct technical product management and Engineering, both dedicated project resources and cross-team dependencies, to ensure rapid, coordinated delivery of the new product
Develop and own relationships with early design partners & ecosystem partners to iteratively shape product requirements, and drive key build/buy/partner decisions
Work with Revenue on go-to-market strategy, materials, marketing and own product line P&L
Work with Legal & Compliance to ensure regulatory compliance across jurisdictions, and help identify opportunities coming out of emerging regulatory directions worldwide
Qualifications
 
10+ years of professional experience
Experience leading complex capital markets technology projects at banks, brokerages, asset managers, fintechs or FMIs
Demonstrated track record of product ownership working with internal and external stakeholders
Deep knowledge of capital markets across the life of the trade trading, financing, risk management and trading controls, clearing and settlement, etc.) and ability to think critically about what changes and what stays the same with tokenized assets
Experience developing crypto or tokenized asset trading, portfolio, clearing & settlement products and demonstrated knowledge of blockchain networks and DeFi
Effective collaboration cross-functionally and cross-product to drive project success in a fast-changing environment

jobs.title: Senior Revenue Architect, Enterprise
jobs.description_text:
Gong harnesses the power of AI to transform how revenue teams win. The Gong Revenue AI Operating System unifies data, insights, and workflows into a single, trusted system that observes, guides, and acts alongside the world’s most successful revenue teams. Powered by the Gong Revenue Graph, AI-powered intelligence, specialized agents, and trusted applications, Gong helps more than 5,000 companies around the world deeply understand their teams and customers, automate critical sales workflows, and close more deals with less effort. For more information, visit www.gong.io.

At Gong, you will join a company built on innovative products, ambitious goals, and passionate people. We are shaping the future of revenue intelligence and we want people who are excited to build what comes next. You will work with a team that dreams big, moves fast, and cares deeply about the craft and about each other. Here, transparency and trust are core to how we operate, and every person has the opportunity to make a visible impact. If you want to grow, stretch, and do work that truly matters, Gong is the place to do the best work of your career.

Enterprise Revenue Architects at Gong are strategic partners to our largest customers. Focused on driving revenue transformation from Gong’s AI Operating System. You’ll guide executive stakeholders and operational teams to drive revenue with Gong by architecting workflows, accelerating adoption, and realizing business results across the entire revenue lifecycle.

You will combine a deep understanding of how revenue teams operate with leading change management strategy to help customers operationalise the use of Gong into tangible business results. Your success is measured by activation and adoption, key persona engagement, customer value realization, and revenue impact (retention and expansion).

RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Revenue Transformation Strategy: Partner with senior GTM leaders to design and execute strategies that modernize their revenue operations through Gong’s AIOS
  • Workflow Architecture: Map current-state customer processes to AI-driven workflows that translate to revenue outcomes
  • Adoption and Change Management: Execute adoption initiatives that drive behavior change and embed Gong into daily team rhythms
  • Value Realisation: Use data-driven insights to quantify measurable business outcomes that demonstrate Gong’s ROI and strategic value
  • Renewal and Expansion Management: Own the renewal strategy and execution, partnering with cross-functional teams on growth
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with internal teams to ensure an exceptional customer experience throughout the entire customer journey
QUALIFICATIONS 
  • 10+ years proven experience in managing complex enterprise accounts with multiple stakeholders
  • Track record owning relationships with senior (VP and C-suite) stakeholders and owning value and ROI conversations
  • Passion for driving customer centricity by leveraging internal stakeholders such as Sales, Product, Support, Marketing and executives
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
  • Data-driven mindset with a focus on delivering measurable outcomes.
  • Passion for driving customer outcomes and contributing to a high performing and accountable work culture
  • Our RAs are self-starters who excel in high paced environments and thrive in change and ambiguity. Our top performers have a growth mindset and pride themselves in being coachable. We are a team that values collaboration and winning together, enjoying the ride, and challenging conventional wisdom. If that’s you too, we want to hear from you!

PERKS & BENEFITS
